user.title: Energy graph
user.description: Name and whole-house energy sensor (used to compute “Other”). Add devices afterwards with “Configure”.

init.title: Tracked devices
init.description: Add as many devices as needed, then choose “Save and finish”.

menu_options.add_energy: Add an energy meter (cumulative Zigbee, or reset daily like Tapo)
menu_options.add_fixed: Add a fixed consumption spread over 24 h (e.g. ventilation)
menu_options.add_light: Add lights (power scaled by brightness while they are on)

add_energy.title: Energy meter
add_energy.description: Energy sensors (kWh/Wh): cumulative or reset daily. They need a state_class of total or total_increasing.

add_fixed.title: Fixed consumption
add_fixed.description: Energy per 24 h, spread evenly over the day.

settings.title: Settings

data.update_minutes: Refresh rate (multiple of 5 min, aligned with Home Assistant statistics)
data.smooth_hours: Counter smoothing: maximum gap between two steps (0 = off)
data.spread_min: Isolated counter step: spread over the previous X minutes (0 = no spreading)
data.standby_wh: Standby: a step up to X Wh (inclusive) is spread since the previous step or midnight (0 = off)

settings.description: A counter that rises in steps (0.01 or 0.1 kWh) is smoothed: each step is spread over the time since the previous one, as long as that gap does not exceed the value below.

add_light.title: Lights
add_light.description: Pick one or more lights with the same maximum power (W at 100% brightness). Power is automatically scaled according to brightness (e.g. 50% brightness = 50% power). All bulbs are summed into a single “Ampoules” layer in the charts. To change a power, remove the light and add it again.

error.bad_state_class_energy: No state_class total or total_increasing: Home Assistant keeps no statistics for it.
error.bad_state_class_power: This sensor does not have state_class measurement.
